release_gate_doc: Owner release targets. Durations are minutes, error limits are counts, and perf R2 is milliseconds. Upgrade boots retain their separate one-minute observation.
boot_check_doc: Recorded checkstart default; checkstart itself retains its current CLI default. This is separate from release soak and upgrade observation durations. R4 requires every enabled module ready within readiness_max_after_hive_seconds after the same boot Hive init-finished marker.
benchmark_doc: Owner target load. Budgets remain provisional until measured at this load; this metadata does not establish multiplayer acceptance.
rpt_category_ceilings_doc: Initial regression ceilings: measured Build 159 counts from framework section 3.5, not acceptance of those defects. Category 15 has no measured count (null blocks release). Lead must rerun the complete taxonomy on current and vanilla RPTs before tightening; final zero/vanilla targets remain pending. Dependency lines count in full. Unclassified diagnostics and oversized lines block release.
readiness_ratchet_doc: R4 uses the same-boot vanilla Hive init-finished marker as baseline. Initial ratchet equals the existing owner limit of 30 seconds; tighten after measured boots, never increase to admit a slower boot. Release requires timing evidence and satisfies both the owner limit and this ratchet.
